headlines.title: Applied Materials Cratered in The last 3 Months: One Wall Street Sell Side Firm Predicts it Will Nearly Double Within 12 Months
headlines.summary: Applied Materials just posted its fifth consecutive earnings beat while the stock cratered 22% in three months, and at least one Wall Street firm thinks that disconnect points to one of the more compelling setups in the chip equipment sector right now.

headlines.title: Applied Materials’ $5 billion AI lab aims to cut chip development time in half—and restore Silicon Valley’s edge
headlines.summary: Applied Materials, the leading maker of chipmaking equipment, officially unveiled its EPIC chip R&D center with partner companies including Intel, Micron, SK Hynix, and Samsung Electronics.

headlines.title: Applied Materials (AMAT) Backs AI Physics Modeling Push For Faster Chip R And D
headlines.summary: Applied Materials (NasdaqGS:AMAT) venture arm Applied Ventures has invested in Flexcompute to support its Physics World Model AI platform. The partnership focuses on AI-driven engineering simulation aimed at faster and more accurate semiconductor R&D workflows. Flexcompute's Physics World Model AI is intended to model physical laws in software to speed up chip and materials prototyping.

headlines.title: Why Applied Materials Sank Today
headlines.summary: Applied Materials gave uncertain 2030 guidance that may have underwhelmed bullish investors.

description: Applied Materials, Inc. provides materials engineering solutions, equipment, services, and software to the semiconductor and related industries in the United States, China, Korea, Taiwan, Japan, Southeast Asia, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through Semiconductor Systems and Applied Global Services (AGS) segments. The Semiconductor Systems segment includes semiconductor capital equipment to enable materials engineering steps, including etch, rapid thermal processing, deposition, chemical mechanical planarization, metrology and inspection, wafer packaging, and ion implantation. The AGS segment offers integrated solutions to optimize equipment and fab performance and productivity comprising spares, upgrades, services, and 200 millimeter and other equipment and factory automation software for semiconductor and other products. It serves manufacturers of semiconductor wafers and chips, and other electronic devices. Applied Materials, Inc. was incorporated in 1967 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, California.
